purpose: Define when JNU research is complete without requiring every candidate to pass.
completion_is_not: a subjective decision that the framework looks good

governance: Attempt ledger complete and immutable in spirit
All formal families have preregistration before outcome inspection
No unresolved critical data-integrity issue in any promoted module
Family-wise multiplicity and cross-family selection bias explicitly accounted for
true_target_validation: Any module promoted from proxy evidence completes true-target confirmation where applicable
At least HAR-RSV and US-to-JNU intraday-path families receive true-OSE terminal dispositions when authorized data becomes available
If approved true-OSE data cannot legally or practically be obtained, framework may close with DATA_BLOCKED rather than inventing proxies
trading_validation: Any module that changes direction or position must have explicit trading translation
Applicable rules pass CPCV/purge/embargo/PBO/DSR/Holm or a preregistered stricter successor
Fees/spread/slippage and liquidity constraints are applied
Forward or genuinely untouched holdout confirmation is completed for finalists
decision_engine: Role separation enforced: direction, risk, event, source-weight, execution
If zero directional modules validate, engine explicitly returns NO_VALIDATED_DIRECTIONAL_EDGE
reproducibility: Config, preregistration, results, reports, provenance hashes and derived non-reconstructive outputs persisted in GitHub/cloud
Personally licensed 225Labo raw data remains local-only
Terminal status can be reproduced from persisted configs plus authorized local data

successful_completion_states.condition: All major candidates terminally classified and at least one true-JNU directional module plus all applicable promotion gates pass.
successful_completion_states.decision_engine: May emit calibrated directional probabilities subject to validated role constraints.

successful_completion_states.condition: All major candidates terminally classified but no true-JNU directional family passes.
successful_completion_states.decision_engine: Must retain NO_VALIDATED_DIRECTIONAL_EDGE; risk/context/execution layers may still be used only within their validated roles.

successful_completion_states.condition: All feasible free/legal families are terminally classified and remaining high-evidence families are blocked solely by unavailable or unauthorized required data.
successful_completion_states.decision_engine: No unsupported promotion; framework is scientifically complete under the current data-rights constraint but not fully target-validated.

reopen_rule: A completed framework is reopened only for genuinely new independent data, a substantively new preregistered family grounded in external evidence, or a documented implementation/data-integrity defect. Parameter rescue alone is insufficient.
